decision: Prepared a source-tiered Algeria country-reference draft, but did not edit finance/model/country-reference.json because no Algeria corridors are modeled yet and wage/marina inputs still need a stronger local source before cascade.

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled from Morocco/Tunisia/Egypt regional maritime-wage anchors and Algeria cost-index leads; Glassdoor Algiers captain salary lead is too generic to use as a T2 maritime source.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Climatescope 2025 Algeria lead reports average electricity price rising from ~$29/MWh in 2023 to ~$31/MWh in 2024; rounded upward to $0.04/kWh for commercial operating conservatism pending Sonelgaz/CREG tariff table.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Climatiq/ADEME grid-mix factor lead reports Algeria electricity supplied from grid at 0.548 kgCO2e/kWh; rounded to 0.55.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth/marina overhead vs Morocco/Tunisia/Egypt anchors; replace with local marina/port fee schedule before final economics.

cost_index.source: Numbeo country/city comparison leads indicate Algeria cost of living below Morocco and near/under Tunisia; use 0.30 draft until a workspace-approved source is captured.

source_leads.name: Climatescope 2025 Algeria
source_leads.evidence: Search result: average electricity price in Algeria increased from ~$29/MWh in 2023 to ~$31/MWh in 2024.

source_leads.name: Climatiq Algeria grid electricity factor
source_leads.evidence: Search result: electricity supplied from grid — Algeria, factor CO2e 0.548 kg/kWh, ADEME source.

source_leads.name: Numbeo Algeria vs Morocco cost comparison
source_leads.evidence: Search result: Morocco cost of living incl. rent 28.0% higher than Algeria; used only as a low-confidence cost-index lead.

source_leads.name: Glassdoor Captain in Algiers lead
source_leads.evidence: Search result reports generic Captain salary in Algiers; not treated as a maritime captain source.

apply_gate: Scrape/verify tariff source page or capture official Sonelgaz/CREG commercial tariff table.
Confirm grid CO2 factor from a stable source or IEA factor table.
Find a stronger local maritime wage or port/service wage proxy, or explicitly keep T4 regional modeled wage.
Only then add the row to finance/model/country-reference.json before any yassir-algeria aggregate run.
